findings.title: Presentation change detection depends on pointer equality
findings.message: CollectionItem contains a *canvas.TiledImage pointer and slices.Equal compares it by pointer identity; that is fine for replacement, but nil/non-nil transitions of Collection are handled. However the function is evaluated in syncChoice where `previous.Collection` and the new one may be compared after the Updater closures read `r.node` — if a record's node is updated before the comparison, stale presentation may be skipped. Verify ordering.
findings.suggestion: Confirm `previous` is the pre-update snapshot and add a test that swaps only a thumbnail pointer.

findings.title: Vertical navigation skipping disabled items changes column
findings.message: For vertical moves, when the target cell is disabled the scan continues along the linear order, so Down can land on an item in a different column or row than expected, and Up/Down can jump over several rows. Left/right is fine, but vertical moves should stay in the same column.
findings.suggestion: For dy != 0, step by `columns` through the same column and stay put if all cells are disabled, instead of scanning linearly.
